case.title: The Airport Lounge Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Skyline Executive Lounge, the loss of a secret new machine has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 6 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The loss of a secret new machine
case.target_fake_identity: Olivia Ashford, a retired government worker people trust
case.escape_plan: Olivia Ashford plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket ripped in two. The time on it is earlier than someone said.

evidence.description: A photo of two guests who say they have never met.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: a page from an account book
evidence.description: A page of numbers that do not add up.

hidden_clues: Olivia Ashford's story about where they were does not match the a torn train ticket.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a retired government worker
solution.reasoning: Olivia Ashford is the hidden person. The main clues (a torn train ticket, a cheap phone) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: At The Skyline Executive Lounge tonight, 6 guests are trapped — and one is lying about who they are. Find the clue that breaks their alibi and name the person behind the loss of a secret new machine. Guests are careful and some clues are fake. Be sharp.
